context: Sakura and Hina watch a rainbow after rain; tender mentor moment.
purpose: Adult writer sharing simple joy with teen mentee.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate delight. Voice opens sharp on the name. Quick breath before the reveal. Warm and unselfconscious, like she can't hold the joy in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, genuine awe. Pause before speaking—a moment of actual looking. Warm, almost reverent tone. Slight uplift on the final word, like she's offering the observation as a gift.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 雨上がりだから、見られた。
lines.en: We only see it because of the rain.
lines.style: Quiet, observant. Gentle logic—not lecturing, just noticing. Warm undercurrent of wonder at how things work. Slight wondering trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Unhurried. Warm contentment in the tone. Looking upward as she speaks. Soft final word, like settling into the moment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft, tentative thoughtfulness. Gentle lilt on the first word. Warm, almost whispered. Like she's deciding aloud, inviting Sakura into the moment without demanding anything of her.
